text.text_excerpt: Loved Mister Mao. We had such a good dining experience. From the food to service, this place is a winner. Hard to describe the type of fare. Felt like a smattering of many types of food. The website says "tropical" and that is kind of right. In the end, who cares. The food was great. Our favorites were the lechon, Hawaiian roles and fried chicken. Honestly, there was so much left on the menu that I really wanted to order. Our server was friendly. Nothing outstanding but totally adequate. We sat in the front of the house and it was ok. Not crowded on a Wednesday but still plenty of people. Next time, I'd like to sit at the bar that faces the kitchen. I bet that is a cool experience. In sho...

Came for the special Christmas Eve menu and it was phenomenal! Requested Chef's Counter seating, and I'm so glad I did - it was so cool being perched right over the kitchen, watching all the dishes be prepared and the finishing touches put on with tweezers. As soon as we were seated, we were presented with an amuse of something spicy with rice crackers- I can't recall the description but it had a tapenade texture (but not the taste). It was great! We both ordered the Man Hands cocktail, which was perfectly balanced and beautifully presented. Really great food and very unique menu! We ordered a bunch of stuff to try and really enjoyed all of it. I would definitely recommend this restaurant, especially if you're an adventurous eater that likes to try new things. We sat the chefs counter and the service was great and it was fun to watch everything being made!
